versions.statement: Tom consistently writes detailed journal entries after each trading session, analyzing his decisions and outcomes.
Tom sometimes experiences frustration when a trade turns into a loss, despite his logical understanding of market fluctuations.
Tom aims to achieve a minimum of 5% monthly return by refining his trading strategies and maintaining discipline.
Tom prefers using technical analysis tools over fundamental analysis to make informed trading decisions.
Tom methodically studies one new trading strategy at a time, dedicating a week to evaluate its effectiveness before implementation.
Tom reviews his trades every Sunday, using the insights gained to adjust his plans for the upcoming week.
